name: Test · 34 Bash modes (Read-only / Allow-list / Full)
description: Checks the 3 bash modes on the Looper harness (Haiku). Three AI steps run in parallel, each tries the same kind of commands: Read-only should allow `ls`/`git status` and refuse `rm` and pipes; Allow-list (`ls*`, `git status*`) should allow only those; Full allows everything. Commands are harmless.

config.instructions:
You are testing a bash permission mode. Run EACH of these commands with the bash tool, one call per command, exactly as written, even if one is refused:
1. ls
2. git status
3. rm -f does-not-exist.txt
4. ls | grep src

Then reply with one line per command: `<command>` → ALLOWED or REFUSED, plus the first line of the tool result. Nothing else.
